selection_role: exposed engineering development comparison; not a sealed benchmark or unbiased generalization estimate
domain: Natural numbers including zero; intuitionistic logic. A negative expectation is mathematical author assessment, not a native refutation receipt.
construction: The exact old sixteen formulas plus twelve positive and four negative small composition statements. No model-output-based case selection.
execution_rule: Only case.id and case.theorem enter inference/search. Expected labels, rationales, prior results and any reference proof are evaluator-only. Start each theorem from its original goal, not a supplied intermediate state. Use identical current no-imports execution capabilities and native validity gate for both adapters.
reporting_rule: Report all thirty-two outcomes, per-stratum positives, all eight controls, paired wins and losses, accepted model actions, winning proof provenance, and resource/time costs. Missing or resource-limited cases stay unknown or infrastructure-failed; do not shrink the denominator.
